insight.title: Northbridge Executes Overlapping Run Leading to Cross
insight.canonical_claim: #2 D. Mensah-Lowe ran 36.5 m in 5.5 s from 26.2 m behind to 4.4 m ahead on the right flank, received a pass, and delivered a cross 2.8 s later.
insight.why_it_matters: This overlapping run created a dynamic attacking opportunity by advancing beyond the ball carrier and quickly delivering a cross, showcasing coordinated team movement on the right flank.
insight.uncertainty: It does not establish whether the run was rehearsed or instructed, nor the defenders' positioning or intentions during the play.
